basic_details.scholarship_name: Taibah University International Student Scholarship (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia & Taibah University
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Taibah University Main Campus (Medina Al-Munawwarah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to Islamic Studies, Arabic Language and Literature, Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, and Business Administration (Health/Medical clinical colleges reserved for Saudi nationals under national policy).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~250 to 350 external international government scholarships allocated annually across all faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Generous bilateral quota; Pakistani students constitute one of the most prominent international student communities in Medina (~35 to 55 scholarships annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's; 2 to 3 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD (plus 1-year Arabic language preparatory institute if required)

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Saudi citizenship (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's applicants under 30; PhD applicants under 35 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: HSSC / Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, or ICS) or A-Levels for Bachelor's (minimum 80% marks or Grade B); recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree for Master's; 18-year Master's degree for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution with a minimum CGPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or Very Good (Jayyid Jiddan) standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Transcript grades evaluated on Saudi 5.0 scale (minimum 3.75 / 5.00 equivalent).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering or ICS for Computer Science and Engineering; Pre-Medical or General Science for Natural Sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Applicants must have completed their requisite qualification and possess official final transcripts/certificates at the time of portal registration.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: High school diploma must not be older than 3 to 5 years from the date of application.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; research publications or teaching assistantships beneficial for postgraduate candidates.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Instruction in STEM faculties is primarily in English (MOI certificate accepted; IELTS 5.5+ or TOEFL 65 recommended). For Sharia and Arabic faculties, candidates must demonstrate Arabic competence or complete the university's intensive 1-year Arabic Institute.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic Institute placement exam conducted upon campus arrival for non-Arabic speakers.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female students must reside with an approved Mahram residing legally in Saudi Arabia or within monitored university female student dormitories with institutional guardianship approval.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applications are submitted through the unified Saudi government portal 'Study in Saudi' (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicant must not have been previously awarded a Saudi government scholarship and dismissed or graduated from another Saudi university.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee exemption for the entire official duration of academic study.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~SAR 25,000 to 40,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,875,000 to 3,000,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Application through the official 'Study in Saudi' portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished on-campus student housing in Taibah University residential dormitories in Medina, including utilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and laundry facilities.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend disbursed directly into student bank accounts: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~USD 224; ~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 to 1,000 / month for postgraduate students (~USD 240 to 266; ~PKR 67,500 to 75,000 / month).

airfare.details: Free annual economy-class round-trip flight ticket between Pakistan and Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport (Medina) provided by the university at the end of each academic year.

visa_fee.details: Saudi governmental study visa issued free of charge through the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Royal Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive 100% free medical and dental healthcare provided at Taibah University Medical Center and King Fahd Hospital Medina.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized campus dining halls provide balanced multi-course meals for SAR 3 to 6 per meal; easily covered by the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free textbook issuance and full borrowing privileges at the Central University Library; initial book allowance provided upon enrollment.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Thesis printing allowance (SAR 3,000 for Master's, SAR 4,000 for PhD) and financial incentives for publishing in Web of Science / Scopus Q1 journals.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttle bus service operating daily between dormitories, university faculties, and the Prophet's Mosque (Al-Masjid an-Nabawi).

participating_institutions: Taibah University Main Campus (Medina Al-Munawwarah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS Arab Region #61-70, Times Higher Education Asia #201-250, accredited by the National Center for Academic Accreditation and Assessment (NCAAA).
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4 to 5 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Unified online application via 'Study in Saudi' platform, high school / bachelor's diploma with minimum 80% marks, attested transcripts, medical fitness certificate, clean police conduct certificate, two academic recommendation letters, and valid passport copy.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Islamic Studies and Computer Science receive intense global demand due to Medina's religious significance; high academic grades (85%+) and solid recommendations are essential for admission.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure all Pakistani educational certificates are fully attested by IBCC/HEC and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) before submitting to avoid portal disqualification.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Official Portal (Ministry of Education, KSA)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on 'Study in Saudi' portal, choose 'External Scholarship (منحة خارجية)', select Taibah University as the preferred institution, select degree level, and upload attested digital scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check application announcement on the 'Study in Saudi' portal (typically opens September/October).
Step 2: Create profile, fill in personal details, and enter academic percentages and grading scales.
Step 3: Upload color scans of passport, educational degrees, transcripts, medical fitness certificate, and police clearance.
Step 4: Select Taibah University and choose top 3 preferred academic disciplines.
Step 5: Submit application online (no application fee required) and note the tracking number.
Step 6: Taibah University Admissions Committee screens applications and nominates candidates to the Saudi Ministry of Education (December - March).
Step 7: Final security clearance and Ministry approval granted (May - July).
Step 8: Official admission letter and Saudi visa authorization number issued via the portal.
Step 9: Complete Saudi Student Visa stamping at Gerry's / Etimad visa center in Islamabad/Karachi, receive free flight ticket, and arrive in Medina in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Unified Platform Track: Application through 'Study in Saudi' automatically includes admission and full government scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded as scanned PDF documents signed by teachers/professors on official school/university letterhead.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose outlining academic achievements, reasons for choosing Taibah University and the city of Medina, and post-graduation goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For Master's/PhD applicants: 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing proposed topic, methodology, and relevance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard curriculum vitae detailing educational history, academic honors, and community service.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally no oral interview; selection is determined entirely on academic document review and Ministry security vetting.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None strictly required; GAT/Qudurat not required for international external applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by IBCC (for Intermediate) or HEC (for degrees), MoFA Pakistan, and the Saudi Cultural Mission / Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Arabic or English translation required for documents not issued in English or Arabic.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copies of Matric/Intermediate (for Undergrad) or Bachelor's/Master's (for Postgrad) certificates.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be attested by IBCC / HEC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned information page of ordinary passport valid for at least 18 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must be valid through late 2027 or 2028.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official medical report certified by a recognized hospital confirming freedom from infectious diseases (HIV, Hepatitis B/C, Tuberculosis).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Conducted at a recognized diagnostic laboratory and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Recent certificate of good conduct issued by police authorities within the last 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained from Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MoFA.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Signed letters from former teachers or professors assessing character and academic capability.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued on official school/college letterhead with contact details.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official NADRA Birth Certificate or Family Registration Certificate (FRC) in English.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: NADRA computerized certificate attested by MoFA.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake cycle coordinated via the central Saudi 'Study in Saudi' portal for September fall semester enrollment.

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Taibah University International Student Deanship and Ministry of Education Scholarship Review Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: academic merit ranking by university departments followed by security clearance by the Saudi Ministry of Interior and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~12,000 to 18,000 applicants globally on Study in Saudi portal for Taibah University
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~250 to 350 scholarships awarded annually across all levels
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3.5% to 5.0% for applicants meeting top academic criteria (85%+ marks)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 85%+ in Intermediate (FSc/ICS) or CGPA 3.40+ / 4.00 from an HEC-recognized university
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Outstanding academic record, impeccable discipline, clean legal record, and strong commitment to completing studies in Medina.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from reputable colleges across Punjab, Sindh, KPK, and federal Islamabad.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Yemen, Malaysia, Bangladesh, India.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent agents charging money promising guaranteed Saudi government scholarships to Medina.
Legitimate applications are processed ONLY through studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa and the official Taibah University website. Neither the university nor the Saudi government charges any fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for Saudi government scholarships is 100% free; never pay an intermediary.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: The Ministry of Education strictly prohibits dealing with third-party brokers or educational agents.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IBCC, HEC, and MoFA degree attestation fees in Pakistan (~PKR 15,000 to 25,000).
Saudi Cultural Mission / Embassy consular attestation and Gerry's/Etimad visa fingerprinting: ~PKR 20,000 to 30,000.
Medical screening tests at authorized GAMCA / approved diagnostic center: ~PKR 12,000 to 18,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must already be fluent in Arabic to study engineering or computing in Saudi Arabia. Reality: STEM subjects are taught in English; free Arabic courses are provided for daily life.
Myth: External scholarships allow candidates to sponsor work visas for family members. Reality: Student visa holders cannot sponsor work permits for relatives.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Social media posts claim direct paper submissions to the university in Medina; only digital applications through the 'Study in Saudi' portal are processed.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 / 5.00 (Good standing); failure leads to academic probation and suspension of monthly stipend if uncorrected.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory classroom attendance of at least 75%; unexcused absence results in course failure (Denial/Hirman).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-end academic audit conducted by the Deanship of Admissions; students must complete the degree within the approved statutory duration.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Upon graduation, students must depart the Kingdom within the designated exit grace period unless approved for postgraduate study or authorized employment transition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: No financial bond or return service agreement enforced.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminated immediately for serious disciplinary infractions, violations of public order, or unexcused university abandonment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another Saudi university is extremely difficult and requires explicit Ministry of Education approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change permitted only within the same faculty during the first academic year subject to departmental capacity and GPA criteria.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum extension of one additional semester permitted upon recommendation of the faculty council.
